acquisition.on_429_or_403: Stop entire acquisition; record Retry-After, keep failed reservation; no automatic retry.

audit.denominator: Report all 100 and both metadata strata; these are deliberately stratified and not a corpus accuracy estimate.
hypotheses: Named-editor provenance may provide source-exact whole ruby readings.
Source-exact readings alone cannot establish intended IME output or Gold quality.
audit.outcomes: Each selected slot retains decode/markup/source-match/coverage status; no replacement.

authority: Authorized autonomous source/data-quality research; no model or trusted-label admission.

isolation.future_splits: Disjoint components for research, calibration and one-use final Test must be frozen before use. This exposed pilot is research only.
isolation.method: Any proposed inputs require complete previous source/input history, all 100 source units, and every proposed span; forward and reverse closure must agree.
isolation.unselected_scope: Binary acquired and metadata scanned; no semantic decode. Future admission still needs exposure and source-lineage audit.

selection.method: Take smallest canonical SHA256(seed,domain,sentence_id) within metadata-only strata.

source.digest_limit: No digest in inspected official index/headers; ETag is not a cryptographic digest. Provisional acquisition only.
source.license: CC BY 2.0 FR for distributed exports; retain original attribution privately
source.license_membership: Require each selected transcription ID to occur in licensed detailed-sentences export.
source.provenance_limit: Editor is source provenance, not our independent A/B reviewer; export omits needsReview and transcription modification time.
